changes: Trimmed to 17.0 to 45.2 s of the kitten original (28.2 s).
Frame rate cut from 120 to 15 frames a second.
Cropped from 16:9 to 4:3: a fixed window 2880 by 2160 from x=640, y=0.
Temporal noise added on all three planes before the encode, with a fixed seed.
Re-encoded as H.264 High profile at 230 kb/s average in two passes.
The kitten's own sound resampled to 48 kHz, its level unchanged.
The park recording's 74.40 to 77.40 s averaged to one channel, resampled to 48 kHz, faded in and out over 20 ms, and mixed in from 6.0 s with no level change to either track.
Sound encoded as AAC LC at 96 kb/s, mono, 48 kHz.
MP4 with the faststart flag; no metadata or chapters copied from the sources.
command: # Stage 1: trim, 15 fps, 4:3 crop, 640x480; lossless working file, picture only.

The bark at 0:06 is from "PARQUE PERROS 7 30 AM" by ALWA198426 (https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:PARQUE_PERROS_7_30_AM.wav), CC0 1.0, mixed in.

words.caption: Sample clip: a kitten grooms itself on a carpet, then walks past the camera. A dog barks at 0:06.
words.description: A light brown kitten sits on a grey carpet close to a camera at floor level, with wooden cabinets and a dark bin behind it, and grooms its chest, paw and face. A dog barks several times out of view from 0:06 to 0:09. At 0:25 the kitten gets up and walks past close to the camera and out of view to the left; the view turns to the right as it passes, then partly back.
